projects.title: Healthcare Appointment System
projects.description: A full-stack healthcare platform for secure registration, doctor discovery, and appointment booking, with admin tools and automated SMS reminders.
projects.details: Built for smoother appointment management, with Twilio reminders and Sentry monitoring. The resume reports testing with 100+ users and a 30% reduction in manual scheduling time.

projects.title: chatApp — Real-Time Messaging
projects.description: A MERN and Socket.io messaging app with online presence, secure authentication, and persistent conversation history.
projects.details: Designed for low-latency conversations with bidirectional WebSocket communication. The resume reports support for 100+ concurrent users and sub-200ms message delivery in testing.
